q1_what_did_you_play: I played Dodoco Blast first, spending 2 Sparks to deal 7 damage to all enemies, killing Twig Slime (S) and reducing both Leaf Slimes. Then I played Kaboom! on Leaf Slime (S), killing it. Finally I played Duck and Cover for 5 Block. I left 1 Energy unused.
q2_other_line_considered: I considered playing Bang Bang! instead of Dodoco Blast, since it also costs 0 and spends 2 Sparks, but its 5 damage twice to random enemies is less controlled and lower total than Dodoco Blast's 7 damage to all enemies, so I rejected it.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 2 Spark bank for future turns and the chance to use Bang Bang!'s random hits. It also left 1 Energy unused, and the 5 Block may be wasted if the remaining Leaf Slime (M) does not attack.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the Leaf Slime (S) were not an immediate attacker or the Leaf Slime (M) telegraphed a larger attack, I would likely retarget Kaboom! at the higher-priority enemy; Dodoco Blast and Duck and Cover would probably remain.
